question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant you hit on the way to Maritime Museum at Battery Wharf, Boston, MA from Copicut Woods Parking, Westport, MA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Copicut Woods Parking%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Maritime Museum at Battery Wharf%' LIMIT 1 ), route_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry)::geography, 1000) AS corridor_geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point s WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT corridor_geom FROM route_corridor)) ORDER BY ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
